en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a close-up photograph of a medieval-style stone or wood sculpture of a crowned figure, likely a king or saint. The figure has long wavy hair, a decorated crown with fleur-de-lis-like elements, a jeweled necklace or chest ornament, and holds a scepter or staff visible on the right. The image fills nearly the whole card and appears to be a reproduction of a museum or cathedral statue. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front.
